title: FM27 Logo Packs — TCM27 Install, Game Pass Path & Blurry Badges
description: FM27 logo packs: what TCM27 contains, the graphics folder per platform including Game Pass, why some badges look pixelated at 512px, and the checks to run when a club badge is still missing.
meta: Updated 13 November 2026 · FM27 released 10 November 2026 · Pack contents and install paths read from the maintainer's own page; the pack is not installed or tested by this site.
body:
TCM27 is the pack to start with, and its install is three steps. The two things that go wrong are putting the folder one level too deep in graphics, and blaming the pack for blurry badges that are actually a display-size setting.

What TCM27 contains

ItemCount / detail
Total logos77,958 — 71,269 clubs, 6,187 competitions, 502 miscellaneous
Coverage232 nations, men's and women's football, plus confederations, flags and federations
Sizes200px, 400px or 512px depending on the logo
New in TCM27512px logos offered for the first time; 1,145 more logos than TCM26
Optional updateTCM27.0 replaces 741 logos with 400px versions (91.1 MB) for sharper rendering on smaller display settings

Install, per platform

  1. Extract the archive. You want the folder named Megapack TCM27.
  2. Put that folder directly inside FM27's graphics folder — not inside another subfolder: Windows: Documents\Sports Interactive\Football Manager 27\graphics macOS: /Users/NAME/Library/Application Support/Sports Interactive/Football Manager 27/graphics Game Pass: Documents\Sports Interactive\Football Manager 27\Gamepass\graphics
  3. Quit and restart the game. The maintainer's answer to “logos don't appear” is consistently: wrong nesting, wrong path for your edition, or the game was not fully restarted.
FM27 also creates a nested games folder inside the user-data directory on some installs. The maintainer's thread has one report of logos only appearing after graphics was moved next to that nested folder. If the standard path fails and everything else checks out, look at the folder tree before reinstalling anything.

Why some badges look pixelated

This is a display-size interaction, not a broken download. FM27 runs on Unity and scales official 512px logos itself, but images supplied by a pack are not scaled the same way. At Medium or Small display settings, 512px badges from the pack can look worse than the official ones. Two fixes, both from the maintainer: set the display preference to Large, or install the TCM27.0 update that swaps 741 logos to 400px.

A badge is still missing after installing

  1. Confirm the club is actually in the pack — coverage is broad but not literally every club in every database.
  2. Check the config file sits in the same folder as the images it describes.
  3. Remove any older logo pack. Two packs pointing at the same club is a known cause of a blank badge.
  4. Restart the game fully rather than reloading a save.
  5. If only the licensed French or Saudi league clubs are affected, remember the game already ships official assets for them — a missing badge there is more likely your install than the pack.

Logos do not fix interface or player faces

A logo pack's compatibility statement does not extend to skins or facepacks. Skins can replace interface bundles and need a backup plan (see FM27 skins); faces are a separate graphics pack (FM27 mods). Install one category at a time so a broken screen has one possible cause.
